integer_vs_ceil_rule.note: the frozen kernel uses ceil(m*alpha); the registered rule uses (m*a+99)//100. They agree for every m in 7..28 with these five levels, and the formal period always has m=28.

ridge.note: every formal-period day must use exactly 28 effective history days

lightgbm.note: every formal-period day must use exactly 28 effective history days

ridge.note: the protection amount is non-decreasing in alpha; because the residual series is continuous, adjacent levels almost always select distinct order statistics, so the changed count is close to the number of comparisons

lightgbm.note: the protection amount is non-decreasing in alpha; because the residual series is continuous, adjacent levels almost always select distinct order statistics, so the changed count is close to the number of comparisons

m7_sorts_normally.expected: ceil(7*0.8)=6 -> the 6th smallest of the seven values = 5.0

negative_correction_retained.note: negative corrections are not clipped at zero

duplicate_values.note: repeated residuals make adjacent levels select the same order statistic

nan_input_must_fail.note: np.sort places NaN last, so a single NaN does not necessarily corrupt the chosen order statistic; the input gate must therefore reject it up front rather than rely on sorting
